class.name: GraphCall
class.brief_description: One run of a graph function that is waiting to finish.
class.description: A call to a graph function that stops at a step that waits, such as a delay or a wait for a signal, returns a [GraphCall] in place of a result. The call keeps the place where it stopped. It carries on when the thing it waits for happens. Connect to [signal completed] to get the result. A call is dropped, without emitting [signal completed], when its instance is freed or its script changes. A function that does not wait returns its result at once and no call is made.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted when the function ends. [param result] is the value the function returned, or [code]null[/code] when it returns nothing.
